summary_for_children: Az-Zumar means The Groups. It calls us to worship Allah sincerely, reminds us of His mercy and that we should never despair of it, and speaks of people going in groups to their final place.
environment_concept: Rain running underground into springs (39:21), crops that grow, turn yellow and dry (39:21) and a soft light on the horizon (39:73; nothing of Paradise is pictured).
architecture_and_scenery: Rainy valley, springs running through rock, crops turning yellow, and a horizon with abstract gates of light.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A field of six plots in a valley after rain, with springs at its edge and a seed bag by the path

primary_mechanic.text: Sow the field after the rain; the plots sprout one after another, turn green, then gold, then dry. Bring each plot in while it is gold. Too early it is green and soft; too late the stalks crumble (39:21) and the plot is sown again, a picture of starting again without despair (39:53). No points are given.

secondary_activities: those who know and those who do not (39:9)
do not despair of the mercy of Allah (39:53)
unique_world.narrative_structure: The sign, the growing field, then the closing reading
environment_behaviour: rain falls before and just after sowing
each plot changes from bare to green to gold to dry
unique_world.learning_objective: See the cycle of rain, crops and drying in 39:21 and learn that one can always begin again (39:53)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Never Lose Hope
story_library.children_narration: Sometimes people make mistakes and feel unsure how to improve. Surah Az-Zumar reminds us not to despair of Allah's mercy. It also asks us to reflect on rain, plants, knowledge, and sincere worship. No matter how difficult something seems, sincere repentance is always meaningful.

world_idea.title: The Valley of Renewal
world_idea.description: Explore a landscape that changes through seasonal growth and discover how correcting mistakes differs from simply hiding them.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
